text:
paul: Quick prelaunch check — kicking off first-light safety sweep for the midnight change window. Key ask: confirm freeze locks, canary pins, rollback lanes. I'm on-call during the window.

sre-oncall: Confirmed host-level locks in place. Monitoring dashboards up. Will watch autoscaling. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pin for release v3.4.1 applied to canary pool. Commands:
```
deploy pin --env=canary --version=3.4.1
```

anna: Thanks. I've run the smoke script against canary - logs look clean. Leaving a note: latency p50 ~ stable.

mary: Release notes pushed to docs. No breaking API changes.

kevin: Do we want to keep embeddings model in quantized mode or switch to fp16 for freshness? perf tradeoff?

paul: Keep quantized for cost during overnight. We'll switch if we see quality regressions.

release-manager: Rollback plan is on the wiki, quick summary: rollback to v3.4.0, route traffic to eu-west-1 fallback if needed. Owners: @sre-oncall, @anna.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I have the cancel pin script ready.

deploy-bot: Alert: Traffic ramp scheduled in 15m. Auto-SLO throttles set to conservative. :rocket:

anna: Last ask: confirm DB migration is no-op during window.

paul: Confirmed no schema changes in this deploy.

kevin: tagging @security for final audit — logging retention updated?

security: Logging retention set to 90d for this release. No PII changes.

paul: Go/no-go? call it in 5. Post a +1 for go.

mary: +1

anna: +1

sre-oncall: +1

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout now. Will monitor error rate.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% -> 30% after 10m -> 100% after 30m if stable.

paul: If error rate >1.5% in any 5m window -> immediate rollback.

sre-oncall: Noted. I have alerts wired.

paul: Thanks team. I'll post a post-mortem template link if anything happens. :thumbsup:
